concerns.text: T007 requires 'Quantify blinding bias (blinded vs unblinded raters)' but no schema field captures rater blinding (cleaned_study.schema.yaml and effect_size.schema.yaml have no blinding field), so the task is unexecutable as written — the data source does not exist. Remove the dimension or add a field to the contracts first.

US1 acceptance criterion requires output `data/raw/excluded_studies.log`, but T004's outputs are only `verified_snapshot_2026.json` and `cleaned_studies.csv`. No task produces the exclusion log, so the deliverable is unreachable.

T004 says 'selecting a single primary control group per treatment arm' while spec FR-008 mandates 'proportional control splitting'. An implementer cannot determine which behavior to build; the plan documents the override but the spec was never reconciled. Same conflict for FR-003 (regex vs keyword pipeline, absent from T004 entirely).

Principle VII requires studies with `delivery_format = unknown` to be excluded from the primary subgroup analysis, but T007 has no step to filter unknown-format entries. Also, effect_size.schema.yaml's `format_tag` enum omits `unknown`, so unknown-format studies cannot produce schema-valid effect-size rows — T005's schema validation will fail for those studies with no specified handling.

Principle VI requires logging search query strings and retrieval timestamps for every included study under `data/`, but no task produces this retrieval log. T004's outputs don't include it, making the audit requirement unexecutable.

plan.md places source under `src/` while tasks.md and the constitution use `code/`. An implementer following plan.md creates the wrong layout. tasks.md should state the authoritative path (code/) and note the plan discrepancy.

FR-014 conditions on suppressing meta-regression when N<10, but no task implements meta-regression at all, so the conditional has nothing to condition on. Either add a meta-regression task (gated on N>=10) or record that subgroup analysis replaces it.
FR-009 (abstract-only extraction fallback) is in plan Task 4 but missing from T004's requirements list; the task as written may skip it.

No task pins random seeds in `code/` (Constitution Principle I) or records checksums for `data/` files (Principle III). T010 verifies CI/local hash equality but nothing creates the checksummed baseline. Add explicit deliverables (e.g., `data/checksums.sha256`).

T006, T009, and T010 lack a Verify clause (T006/T009 have outputs but no named confirmation; T010's 'identical artifacts' check needs a specified mechanism, e.g., hash comparison script). T009 also has no named test for the N<10 branch.
